articles.title: Ether and XRP ETFs post outflows as bitcoin moves above $77,000
articles.snippet: Ether funds shed money for a third straight session even as the token rose, while every major gained and zcash extended its run.

articles.title: Group behind Revolut data breach demands $3 million in Monero, threaten to sell customer data
articles.snippet: The group gave Revolut 24 hours to pay and said it targeted customers with significant crypto holdings. Revolut said it has not not received any direct contact from the individuals.

articles.title: World launches self-custodial ‘super app’ World Money
articles.snippet: World Money is rolling out across more than 150 countries, combining stablecoin payments, digital asset rewards and trading in a self-custodial app.

articles.title: North Korea drives onchain malware surge, CoinEx shuts: Asia Express
articles.snippet: North Korea and Iran account for the majority of onchain malware, while Malaysia has been named among the most crypto curious Islamic nations.

articles.title: WisdomTree, MoonPay team up to expand US access to tokenized money market fund
articles.snippet: MoonPay plans to use WisdomTree’s $1.2 billion WTGXX tokenized fund as part of its stablecoin reserves while helping expand access to US investors.
